text:
sofia: Heads-up — I ran the compare table with the new 3-column density and noticed performance microbadges get visually clipped when a version is pinned. screenshot: https://redwood.design/snap/pxl123 (shows chevron overlapped)
jamal: Ugh, can repro. Seems like badges and the pin chevron are competing for the same horizontal space — flex shrink + z-index issue.
alex: Two quick options: 1) increase badge container padding and push the pin to the far right, or 2) switch badges to icons-only in the dense layout.
maria: Icons-only worries me for discoverability — those badges convey perf/cost meaning. Maybe icons-only by default but reveal full label on hover/tooltip?
design-bot: Accessibility note: green perf microbadge at 12px fails AA contrast (ratio < 4.5:1). Also ensure the badge text is reachable by screen readers (aria-label="Perf: 99ms p95").
pm-ash: From product — keep density toggle, but default new users to 'comfortable'. Also prefer explicit microcopy: show "Pin version" on hover or accessible label rather than relying solely on the pin icon.
sam: Prototype idea: collapse secondary metadata (latency, cost) into a hover panel / disclosure on compact rows to free up width for badges + pin.
sofia: I like tooltip + explicit copy. Proposal: badges become icons-only under 960px width; show full badge text on hover/focus; change pin hover text to "Pin version". I'll mock three states (comfortable, compact, compact+icons).
jamal: If we go icons-only we need to update keyboard nav and focus order and ensure SRs announce full text. Also watch for tab order when the hover panel appears.
maria: I'll write a few copy variants: "Pin version", "Pin for rollout", "Pin to release" — which reads best to users?
pm-ash: "Pin version" is my pick — concise and clear.
design-bot: Attached WCAG checklist and recommended token swaps (higher contrast tokens for badge backgrounds). Also: ensure focus ring is 3px and visible on dark mode. Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/redwood/catalog-badges
sam: I'll try a quick CSS experiment and push a playground patch: 

```css
.catalog-row.dense .badge { padding: 0 6px; }
.catalog-row.dense .badge.condensed { font-size: 12px; }
.catalog-row.dense .pin-button { order: 3; margin-left: auto; }
```

will share a preview link when up.
sofia: Great — please drop the Figma mock and the patch here. I'll review in tomorrow's design sync and we can decide whether to do icons-only or tooltip-first. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
